eyebrow.zh: 中文 · 省token · 按模型实测
eyebrow.en: Chinese · Save tokens · Measured per model

headline.zh:
一句中文 prompt
按模型量出能省多少 token
headline.en:
One Chinese prompt
the real savings, measured per model

sub.zh: 中文 prompt 在不同模型上 token 数差 >5%。wenyan 用每个模型自己的计数方式量出真实开销，再量压缩后净省多少——不是估算，是实测。
sub.en: The same Chinese prompt costs >5% different tokens per model. wenyan counts the real cost on each model's own terms, then the net savings after a rewrite — not an estimate, a measurement.

hero.command: git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/wenyan && cd wenyan && uv pip install -e .

title.zh: 同一句中文，三个模型 token 数差 >5%
title.en: Same Chinese line, >5% token gap across three models

body.zh: 中文 prompt 在不同模型上 token 数不同——有的切得碎，有的切得密。wenyan 一条命令量出来，换模型到底差多少，一眼可见。
body.en: Chinese prompts cost different tokens per model — some split finer, some denser. One command measures the gap, so switching models shows its real price at a glance.

title.zh: 压缩一句中文，每模型净省 token
title.en: Compress one Chinese line, net savings per model

body.zh: 压缩后比压缩前净省多少 token，按模型量出来——每个模型都量成正向，不是压完不看账。
body.en: How many tokens the rewrite actually saves, per model — measured net-positive on every model, not compressed-and-forgotten.

title.zh: 装进 Skill，Agent 直接套用
title.en: Drop in the Skill, your agent applies it

body.zh: 一份 markdown Skill 放进你的编码 Agent，它就按实测套用中文压缩。不用改工作流，不用起服务。
body.en: One markdown Skill into your coding agent and it applies the measured Chinese compression. No workflow change, no server to run.

body.zh: 每个模型用自己真实的计数方式量 token——不靠经验系数猜。给的是你账单上会看到的那种数。
body.en: Every model counts tokens its own real way — no heuristic fudge factor. The numbers are the kind you'll see on your bill.

headline.zh: 一句中文，量出能省多少

sub.zh: 一条命令，三个模型的 token 实测 + 净省。
sub.en: One command, three models' real tokens + net savings.
